create_feedback_record: create a feedback record with run_id thread_id and a rating of plus one or minus one
get_feedback_by_id: get a single feedback record by its feedback_id with optional user_id filtering
list_feedback_by_run: list all feedback records for a specific thread and run with optional user filtering and limit
upsert_feedback: upsert feedback for a thread run and user combination creating or updating the rating and comment
aggregate_feedback_by_run: aggregate feedback statistics for a run returning total positive and negative counts
